# Kids Learn AI

> Kids Learn AI provides live online Python and age-appropriate AI classes for children ages 9–13 in Canada. Students learn through instructor-led projects, small-group collaboration, and responsible AI activities.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/): Program overview and learning approach
- [Program details](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/inquiry): Age groups, schedules, curriculum, pricing, and free trial
- [Pricing](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/pricing): Current founding rate and included services
- [Curriculum](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/lessons): Python and AI course sequence
- [Blog](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/blog): Practical guides for families and educators
- [About](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/about): Mission and teaching principles
- [FAQ](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/faq): Answers to common family questions
- [Contact](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/contact): Contact information

## Editorial information

Blog articles are authored and reviewed by the Kids Learn AI Education Team. Where an article makes factual or statistical claims, primary sources are linked in the article.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/terms)
- [Sitemap](https://www.kidslearnai.ca/sitemap.xml)

Authenticated student, family, tutor, quiz, lab, settings, teacher-notes, and administrative areas are private and should not be indexed or summarized.
